sourceReview.reason: The full Unchained report attributes an approximately $20 million weekly figure to a Coinbase executive, but explicitly says he did not define whether it represents trading volume, token issuance, or net deposits. No independent primary metric or second full-text report verifies the figure, so the lead is not sufficiently evidenced.
